patterns: Single-fact 'who/what' items dominate: plants have life = J.C. Bose, thermal ionisation = Saha, father of atomic energy = Bhabha, 'The Man Who Knew Infinity' = Ramanujan.
APPSC asks first-woman items (first Indian woman science PhD = Kamala Sohonie) and discoverer one-liners (radioactivity = Becquerel; Radio Astronomy Centre = Ooty).
World-physicist discoveries recur (nucleus = Rutherford, photoelectric effect = Hertz, relativity = Einstein).
App leans on multi-statement honours/years sets and title-match lists; exam keeps to one name per question.
